children: Debenhams Group's fiscal first-half performance update is encouraging, Panmure Liberum's Wayne Brown and Anubhav Malhotra write in a note. The U.K. clothing retailer maintained its fiscal 2027 guidance amid a continuing turnaround after it reported accelerated growth through the period. "The turnaround has moved beyond cost-cutting into accelerating demand, improving mix and sharply better cash conversion," they say. If the company continues to deliver, that could lead to a material rerating as Debenhams increasingly appears as a cash-generating marketplace rather than an online fashion retailer facing structural challenges, they add. Boohoo Group, which trades as Debenhams, shares are up 1% at 0.25 pounds. ( najat.kantouar@wsj.com)
